objective: Proof where possible: which pairs of a weave patch no bond holds; the smallest case (a lone double meeting); closed weaves.
status: Proved 2026-11-18 (referee pending): two knots sharing two distinctions leave their lone, opposite-class, facing distinctions unbonded; sketched by the advisor and checked computationally: on weave patches without holes a cyclic height-distance criterion gives the constrained sets and D(x,y) + D(y,x) = 3 steps, so bond distance is at least steps apart + 1.
title: Lone distinctions in the weave
